exact_claim: Across 9 discordant cells, mean subsample stability is 0.684 while mean accuracy (ARI) is -0.003, with column-permuted null at ~0.01.
audit_findings: Values match results/stability/subsample_stability_summary.csv exactly. However, discordance is conditional on post-hoc non-degeneracy Rule i (excluding trivial 1-cluster partitions). Unconditional discordance includes all 18 cells.
required_remediation: Must report both unconditional (all 18 cells) and conditional results side-by-side; explicitly disclose Rule i as post-hoc.

exact_claim: Cohort-clustered bootstrap confirms positive stability-accuracy gap of +0.485 (95% CI [+0.379, +0.662]; unconstrained +0.464 [+0.363, +0.607]).
audit_findings: Bootstrap replicates confirm numeric intervals. However, biological inference across N=6 cohorts has broad uncertainty; clustering 9 cells across 6 cohorts has small-sample bootstrap limitations.
required_remediation: Acknowledge small-cluster bootstrap limitations on n=6 biological cohorts; label analysis as exploratory.

exact_claim: Neither bipartite consensus alone (0.046) nor random gating (0.046 dense, 0.047 bipartite) improves significantly on ambient consensus (0.037).
audit_findings: Ablation factorial decomposition confirms cell values: V0=0.037, V1=0.046, V3=0.046, V4=0.047. Differences from ambient baseline are statistically indistinguishable.
required_remediation: Retain as verified null finding; ensure terminology correctly distinguishes random gating from ambient.

exact_claim: BGSS raises ARI to 0.217 under bipartite consensus (+0.169 over matched random gating, 95% CI [+0.036, +0.310], Wilcoxon p=0.031 uncorrected).
audit_findings: Mean ARI 0.217 is heavily skewed: Leukemia (0.600) and SRBCT (0.546) carry the effect; median ARI is only 0.061. Wilcoxon p=0.031 is uncorrected on n=6 cohorts and not significant under family-wise correction.
required_remediation: Report median alongside mean; explicitly highlight the two-cohort concentration (Leukemia and SRBCT); report Holm-corrected p-value.

exact_claim: BGSS raises ARI to only 0.077 under dense consensus (+0.031 over random, 95% CI [-0.062, +0.149]).
audit_findings: Numeric values matched. The dense consensus arm V2 reaches 0.077. Confirms that BGSS alone without bipartite anchor formulation has muted impact.
required_remediation: Preserve finding; avoid claiming general BGSS superiority outside the bipartite anchor regime.

exact_claim: Determinacy-based certified core anchors add no measurable benefit over uniform random landmarks (Delta = +0.019, p = 0.84).
audit_findings: Knockout 4 (V5 - V4 = +0.019, p=0.84) verifies that Proposition 2 sample determinacy bounds for core anchors do not improve clustering performance over random landmarks.
required_remediation: Downscale theoretical claims regarding Proposition 2; state transparently that determinacy certification is an empirical null.

exact_claim: Across 13 multi-domain benchmarks (3000 model fits), omnibus differences among 10 methods are not statistically significant (Friedman p = 0.40, CD = 4.62).
audit_findings: Friedman test chi^2=9.41, p=0.400 across 13 datasets. ICC-v2 overall rank is 5.62 (5th of 10). Nemenyi CD=4.62. No method dominates across all 13 multi-domain datasets.
required_remediation: Explicitly acknowledge that ICC-v2 is not a universal benchmark winner, but specifically tuned for high-D bimodal regimes.

exact_claim: High-dimensional distance concentration erases cluster margins; Chebyshev spectral clustering retains ARI 0.597 at D_noise=200.
audit_findings: Synthetic isotropic noise simulation verifies degradation curves. Chebyshev polynomial approximation maintains contrast longer than standard Euclidean affinity.
required_remediation: Ensure simulation regime is described as synthetic Gaussian positive control, not biological validation.

exact_claim: High subsample stability does not imply clustering accuracy in high-D cohorts: models with stability > 0.6 frequently exhibit ARI <= 0.05.
audit_findings: Core discordance thesis verified across models (K-Means, Ward, Spectral, DEC, Standard Consensus) on high-D cohorts.
required_remediation: Maintain as primary empirical thesis of the paper; clarify boundary conditions where discordance is strongest.

exact_claim: Stable but discordant partitions in Prostate cohort correlate with PC1 (r = 0.77-0.86) and total library size / sequencing depth.
audit_findings: Correlation analysis shows that spurious high-stability partitions reflect technical depth/intensity variation rather than tumor subtypes.
required_remediation: Highlight library depth as a key technical confounder driving spurious stability in uncurated cohorts.

exact_claim: FastMVC baseline represents FastMICE (Huang et al., IEEE TKDE 2023).
audit_findings: Implementation in src/icc/baselines/anchor.py is an internal random-subspace bipartite proxy that does not compute FastMICE exemplar selection or bipartite spectral partition.
required_remediation: Finding F-23 remediation: designate method explicitly as FastMVC-Surrogate with formal citation to Huang et al. 2023, disclosing surrogate nature.

exact_claim: Extreme scalability adheres to empirical power law with scaling exponent beta = 0.755 +/- 0.074 (Config A) and 0.873 +/- 0.061 (Config B).
audit_findings: Log-log regression on runtime from N=10^4 to 10^6 confirms sublinear scaling exponents on synthetic data.
required_remediation: Clarify that empirical power law applies to anchor graph construction with fixed m, not full spectral eigensolve.

exact_claim: BGSS selects 27 of top 50 Golub diagnostic markers on Leukemia (54.0% vs 15.0% random; hypergeometric p = 1.2e-8).
audit_findings: Hypergeometric test verified. However, this is an exploratory biological validation on a single cohort (Leukemia) and cannot be generalized across all cancer types.
required_remediation: Label marker enrichment as post-hoc biological validation on a single benchmark dataset; do not claim clinical diagnostic validation.

exact_claim: Standard variance filtering captures only 8 of top 50 Golub markers (16.0%; hypergeometric p = 0.38).
audit_findings: Matches Golub dataset variance ranking. Confirms that high variance is often dominated by housekeeping or non-discriminative genes.
required_remediation: Preserve as evidence that bimodality (BGSS) targets discriminative signals better than simple variance on this cohort.

exact_claim: Bipartite graph compression reduces consensus graph memory by 99.6% at N=10^4 (0.31 MB vs 76.3 MB for dense consensus).
audit_findings: Dense matrix requires N*(N-1)/2 floats = 10000*9999/2 * 4 bytes = ~200MB (or 76.3MB float32 packed). Bipartite matrix requires N*m = 10000*8 * 4 bytes = 0.32 MB. Reduction is mathematically and empirically 99.6%.
